inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. You can also download our app for Android and iOS .
inputs.modified_text: The real issue is whether public resources are being turned into private profit while political connections shield powerful interests from scrutiny. KT Rama Rao has accused the Congress government of failing to act on illegal mining and alleged that Raghava Constructions, linked to Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is involved. These are allegations, but they deserve an independent, transparent investigation—not dismissal as political point-scoring. When communities bear the costs and well-connected actors may benefit, accountability and protection of the public interest must come first.
